title: Determination of kinetic parameters and computational simulation of perfluoropolyter (PFPE) employed as a synthetic lubricant.
abstract: © 2019 Sociedade Brasileira de Quimica. All rights reserved.This work aims to determine the kinetic parameters of the thermal decomposition of a lubricating grease based on perfluoropolyether (PFPE) and the computational simulation of this decomposition. The determination of kinetic parameters of thermal decomposition was done by thermal analysis using thermogravimetry (TG) at different heating rates (β) of 10, 15 and 20 °C min-1. With the TG curves obtained, the kinetic parameters were determined by the kinetics methods of Goldfarb et al. and Duvvuri et al., Flynn-Wall-Ozawa and Kissinger. The activation energy of the thermal decomposition of the PFPE grease in the kinect models ranged from 63.54 to 112.3 kJ mol-1. The results of the thermogravimetry indicated that the PFPE grease is thermally stable up to 300 °C. A simulation of the thermal decomposition of the PFPE oil base was carried out by molecular dynamics simulation, using LAMMPS (Large-scale Atomic/Molecular Massively Parallel Simulator) in a temperature range of 0 to 3500 K during 50 ps. The value of the activation energy in the simulation was 92 kJ mol-1. The results show that PFPE oil base and PFPE lubricant grease can be used in high-temperature applications.
